title: Retrofit guide Troubleshooting omits the .gitattributes line-merge
reason: The Troubleshooting row describing 'the only intended modification' to a retrofitted repo lists the settings.json merge and the CLAUDE.md marker block but omits the .gitattributes line-merge, which the lifecycle smoke test pins as expected behaviour. Pre-existing and unrelated to Codex; surfaced by P15.S5 and carried through P15.REVIEW, whose phase.md Open Questions archive with the phase.
